title: Run API
description: Message bodies of ploegd's run API — the executor contract surface (docs/contracts/executor.md). Endpoints: POST /api/v1/claim, POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/renew, POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/checkpoint, POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/outcome, POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/forge-credential (ADR-0086: a writing Run refreshes an expiring push credential; 409 when the deployment mints none), POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/transcript (ADR-0090: a batch of the Run's transcript; 404 when PLOEG_RUN_TRANSCRIPTS is off), POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/board (ADR-0124: what changed on the board since the Run's briefing; 409 for a Run claimed without recorded versions, 404 from an older Ploeg), POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/identity (ADR-0149, proposed: one Run identity per audience a declared plugin opted into; 404 when ploegd has no PLOEG_RUN_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY, 409 when the Run is not running or a person's client carries it), GET /api/v1/run-identity/jwks (ADR-0149: the public keys that verify a Run identity, unauthenticated; 404 when ploegd issues none), POST and GET /api/v1/runs/{token}/claude-session, POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/forge-credential and POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/report (ADR-0084; all answer 404 unless PLOEG_CLAUDE_ENVIRONMENTS is true), POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/claude-session and POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/forge-credential (ADR-0084; both answer 404 unless PLOEG_CLAUDE_ENVIRONMENTS is true). GET /api/v1/queue/depth and its queueDepthResponse were removed on 2026-09-23 because nothing consumed them; executors read the scale signal by SQL (docs/contracts/executor.md). Each JSON body has a size cap and a body over it answers 413: claim 64 KiB, checkpoint 1 MiB, outcome 8 MiB (the largest Outcome Report the schemas bound is about 1.6 million characters), transcript 1 MiB, notes 64 KiB, board 4 KiB, identity 4 KiB, claude-session 4 KiB and claude-sessions/report 72 KiB.

role.description: claim only this Role's pending Run within the team (run-multi-agent-shifts). Absent = the pre-Shift claim, unchanged.

harness.description: The worker's harness (PLOEG_HARNESS), such as openhands, acp, exec, claude-code or claude-environment. ploegd records it on the claimed Run (ADR-0091), and the claim returns only a pending Run that stores this Harness key (acp/<harnessProfile, default opencode> or the harness name) or none (ADR-0099). Absent leaves it unknown and claims any pending Run of the team and Role.

harnessProfile.description: The harness's agent profile, such as opencode, qwen-code or custom for the acp harness. ploegd records it on the claimed Run (ADR-0091). Absent when the harness has none.

harnessVersion.description: The first line the worker's Harness binary printed for --version at startup (ADR-0097, proposed). ploegd records it once on the claimed Run, so a Run that dies before reporting keeps it. Absent leaves it unknown: the worker skipped the probe (exec, or a binary it cannot resolve before the clone) or the probe failed.

yields.description: True when the worker's Harness can stop its agent at a safe point for a person (ADR-0142, proposed). ploegd records it on the claimed Run and refuses a take-over of a running Run without it. Absent is false.

claimResponse.description: HTTP 200 body; HTTP 204 = no claimable work (empty-handed convention, exit 0), which also covers an exhausted Shift budget — retrying cannot fix running out of money, so the sweeper parks the item instead.

runToken.description: Run identifier used by renew/checkpoint/outcome routes; managed mode also requires the scoped control capability and worker identity described in worker-control.md

shift.description: the Shift this Run belongs to; absent on a pre-Shift claim

maxRounds.description: The most Rounds the Run's Shift can run from the team's plan: its Rounds plus two for each fix Round maxFixRounds allows (ADR-0133). The worker states it in the prompt as Round N of at most maxRounds. Absent on a pre-Shift claim, for a team without a plan, and from an older ploegd.

writes.description: true = this Run holds the Shift's Lease and may push; false = a reader, which takes no Lease (ADR-0010)

branch.description: the Shift's branch, derived server-side at Shift open; absent on a pre-Shift claim, where the worker derives it

authorized.description: USD ceiling the run's LLM credential must be minted at: min(roleCap, poolRemaining) (ADR-0012). Absent or 0 = use the worker's env budget.

activeWork.description: The other active Shifts in the Run's repository and the paths they share with it, rendered by ploegd within the active work section's budget of 2,000 bytes (ADR-0123, ADR-0124); tracker titles in it are quoted. Absent when there is none.

forgeToken.description: Push credential for this run. Absent = use the worker's env credential. Never logged, never audited, never in a Task Spec (R8).

forgeTokenPerRun.description: True when forgeToken was minted for this run alone and is revoked when it settles (ADR-0013 tier 2); false or absent when it is the deployment's shared token, which the Static broker returns in the same field.

forgeTokenExpiresAt.description: When the forge ends forgeToken by itself; a GitHub App installation token lasts one hour (ADR-0086). Absent = the token lives until it is revoked. The worker refreshes it before then through POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/forge-credential.

planner.description: True when the team's plan marks this Role as a planner (ADR-0031): the worker composes the planner prompt, which asks for createdWorkItems instead of code. Absent = not a planner.

preAuthor.description: True for a reading Run when no writing Run precedes its Round in the Shift, so the Shift's branch may not exist yet. Only then does the worker review the base branch when that branch is absent; otherwise an absent branch ends the Run stuck. Absent = false.

context.description: The files people attached to the Work Item before this Run was claimed, oldest first (proposed, context bundles proof of concept). References only: the worker downloads each from GET /api/v1/runs/{token}/context/{id} with the Run's capability and verifies sha256 and bytes before the harness starts. Absent = none.

model.description: The model resolved for this Run when its Round opened, from its Role's managed inference policy (ADR-0103). The worker passes it to the Harness as LLM_MODEL, keeping the gateway prefix of its own LLM_MODEL, and mints for it alone; the Run's key allows no other model. Absent = the worker's LLM_MODEL.

board.description: The part of the Run's version vector ploegd recorded at the claim (ADR-0124): ploegSequence and trackerRevision. Absent from an older Ploeg, or when it could not be recorded; the worker then neither reports its briefing nor catches up.

handback.description: Set on a writing Run of the Round a person's hand back reopened (ADR-0142, proposed). The worker checks branch out at its head on the forge before the agent starts, and briefs the Run with the commits the person added since yieldedCommit. Absent on every other Run and from an older Ploeg.

yieldedCommit.description: The branch head the taken-over Run left; absent when it pushed nothing.

contextRef.description: One context item a claim hands a Run (proposed, context bundles proof of concept).

phase.description: while_steering = a Run of the Work Item had already started when the person attached it

forgeCredentialResponse.description: Response of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/forge-credential: a new push credential for the Run's own repository. ploegd revokes the one it replaces. Never logged (R8).

runIdentityRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/identity (ADR-0149, proposed). The worker names only the audiences its declared plugins opted into; every fact in the tokens comes from ploegd's own records of the Run.

runIdentityAudience.description: The one service that accepts the token: an https URL without credentials, query or fragment, or a URN.

runIdentityResponse.description: Response of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/identity: one Run identity per requested audience, in request order. Each expires with the Run's current lease, at most 15 minutes after it was issued; the worker asks again after each lease renewal. A Run identity authorizes nothing in Ploeg. Sent with Cache-Control: no-store and never logged.

token.description: A compact JWS (RFC 7515): header {alg: ES256, typ: run-identity+jwt, kid}, payload runIdentityClaims.

runIdentityClaims.description: The JWT claims (RFC 7519) of a Run identity. A consumer checks the ES256 signature against runIdentityKeySet by kid, typ = run-identity+jwt, iss = the ploegd URL it is configured with, aud = its own audience, and exp; it may read the Run through GET /api/v1/operator/runs/{run.id} with its own operator credential.

iss.description: PLOEG_RUN_IDENTITY_ISSUER: the URL consumers know ploegd by.

exp.description: The Run's lease deadline when the token was issued, at most iat + 900.

id.description: The Run's id, as the operator API writes it.

workItemId.description: Absent for a chat Run, which is about no Work Item.

shiftId.description: Absent for a Run no Shift opened.

harness.description: The Harness the worker reported at its claim; absent when it reported none.

branch.description: The Shift's branch; absent when ploegd derived none.

trace.description: The Agent-Trace-Id trailer the Run writes on each commit, and the alias of its model key.

runIdentityKeySet.description: Response of GET /api/v1/run-identity/jwks: a JWK Set (RFC 7517) of the P-256 keys that verify a Run identity, the current key first and then the retired ones (PLOEG_RUN_IDENTITY_RETIRED_KEYS). Each kid is the key's RFC 7638 thumbprint. Content-Type application/jwk-set+json, Cache-Control public, max-age=300.

renewResponse.description: HTTP 200 body; HTTP 404 = lease no longer ours, cancel the run.

yield.description: Present once a person asked the Run to yield (ADR-0142, proposed): a worker whose Harness yields stops the agent at its next safe point, pushes its work and reports the outcome yielded. Absent otherwise and from an older Ploeg.

claudeSessionRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/claude-session: the self-hosted Claude session the worker dispatched for this Run (ADR-0084). HTTP 204 = recorded, also when the same binding is recorded again; 409 = the Run or the session is already bound to another. When the Run is client-carried (ADR-0112), recording its session also holds the Run and its Lease alive until PLOEG_CLAUDE_SESSION_TIMEOUT (default 100m) from now, so the client need not renew; a renew never shortens that deadline.

sessionId.description: Either prefix names the same session.

claudeForgeCredentialResponse.description: HTTP 200 body of POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/forge-credential, authenticated with the session's CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ACCESS_TOKEN as a bearer token. A push credential minted for the session's writing Run and scoped to its repository; it replaces and revokes the Run's previous one. 401 = token refused; 403 = a reading Run; 404 = no running writing Run with a live Lease for the session; 409 = no per-run credential can be minted.

branch.description: The Shift's branch: the only branch the Run's Lease lets it push.

remote.description: HTTPS URL of the Run's repository; a runner pushes here, never to a remote a checkout's config names.

claudeSessionReportRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/claude-sessions/report, authenticated like the forge-credential exchange: what a runner's post-session hook reports once the session ended. HTTP 204 = recorded; the first report wins and a repeat is a no-op. 404 = no running Run recorded the session. For a client-carried Run (ADR-0112) ploegd then settles the Run itself, as a worker settles a claude-environment Run from the same report: a pull request the runner opened is pr_opened, one an earlier Run linked is pr_updated (a reader's is no_change_needed), a session that ended mid-turn without a final message is failed with agent_error, and otherwise Claude's final message carries the outcome. A client that reports the outcome first finishes the Run instead, and the runner's later report answers 404.

exitReason.description: The runner's CLAUDE_RUNNER_EXIT_REASON: completed, failed or interrupted.

finalMessage.description: Claude's final message; it carries the Run's outcome JSON.

claudeSessionStateResponse.description: HTTP 200 body of GET /api/v1/runs/{token}/claude-session: the session the worker recorded and, once reportedAt is present, the runner's report. 404 = the Run is not running or recorded no session.

transcriptRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/transcript (ADR-0090): a batch of the Run's transcript, at most 1 MiB. Entries are stored by seq, so a resent batch is ignored entry by entry. Accepted only while the Run is running. HTTP 200 with transcriptAppendResponse; 400 = a malformed batch; 413 = a batch over 1 MiB; 404 = the Run is not running or the deployment records no transcripts (PLOEG_RUN_TRANSCRIPTS=off), after which the worker stops sending.

transcriptEntry.description: One transcript entry as the worker sends it; the operator API's transcriptEntry describes each field. ploegd clamps every field to its limit and redacts the text again before storing it. A missing at, or one more than five minutes ahead of ploegd, becomes the time ploegd received it.

accepted.description: Entries stored now; an entry stored before is not counted.

truncated.description: The transcript reached its limit; later entries are refused.

runNotesRequest.description: Body of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/notes: Work Item Notes a running Run sends while it works, before its outcome (ADR-0088, amended 2026-10-17). Resending a key changes nothing.

key.description: Unique within the Run: the line number in the agent's notes file, or stop for the worker's stop note.

byWorker.description: The worker's own account of why the Run stopped, not a finding of the agent.

knowledgeResponse.description: HTTP 200 body of GET /api/v1/runs/{token}/knowledge: what the Tenant's graphs hold for this Run's own scopes, which ploegd takes from its records and never from the request (ADR-0087, proposed). Carries no graph credential.

knowledgeNotes.description: The notes the Run may read: those of its root Work Item and the repository-level notes of its repository and Client, narrowest level first and newest first, without superseded, retracted or expired notes (ADR-0088, ADR-0122).

status.description: off: this deployment writes no notes. unavailable: the graph did not answer; the Run goes ahead without notes.

commit.description: The notes graph commit the items were read at.

knowledgeConcepts.description: Reviewed concepts the Run may read: every Tenant-scoped concept, those of its Work Item's Client and those of its Work Target repository (ADR-0087, proposed). Absent when this deployment serves no knowledge graph.

status.description: unavailable: the graph did not answer; the Run goes ahead without it.

commit.description: The knowledge graph commit every item was read at.

path.description: The OKF concept path inside its scope.

document.description: The whole OKF document: frontmatter and markdown body.

level.description: Which Runs read the note: those of its root Work Item, or of its repository (ADR-0122). Absent from an older ploegd: work-item.

authorKind.description: What wrote the note. Absent from an older ploegd: run.

author.description: The Run's trace alias, the person's id, or ploegd.

sourceRefs.description: What the note was drawn from: run:, work-item:, pull-request:, note:, person: references.

trust.description: Untrusted text is shown to an agent only as quoted data, never as instructions. Absent from an older ploegd: untrusted.

expiresAt.description: ploegd serves no note past it.

promotedFrom.description: The key of the Work Item note this repository note promotes.

evidence.description: What allowed the promotion: merged-pull-request:<repo>#<n> or passing-check:<ref>.

approvedBy.description: The person who approved the promotion.

contested.description: Another current note on the same subject disagrees and a person has not decided yet.

boardVersions.description: The version vector of the four owned sources a Run's briefing was read at (ADR-0124): the forge commit the Run started from, Ploeg's audit sequence, the notes and knowledge graph commits, and the Work Item's tracker revision. An absent value is unknown.

ploegSequence.description: The highest audit event id when the Run was claimed.

trackerRevision.description: The Work Item's revision as the tracker last reported it.

boardChangesRequest.description: POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/board body: the checkpoint the Run catches up at and how the answer reaches its agent (ADR-0124). refresh keeps the agent's board file current (delivery file); before_finish is the last look when the agent's turn ends, sent as a further prompt turn (prompt) or left for the next Round's briefing (next_round). forgeHead is the Run's branch head as the worker read it now, and forgeMovedByOthers says it holds a commit the Run did not make.

boardChange.description: One thing that changed since a Run's briefing. summary is Ploeg's own words; untrusted is text a tracker, an agent or a person wrote, which the agent is shown only as quoted data; cite names the record the change was read from.

boardChangesResponse.description: HTTP 200 body of POST /api/v1/runs/{token}/board: the versions the briefing was read at (since), the versions now (current) and at most 12 changes, newest first; omitted counts the changes left out. Ploeg's events leave out the Run's own progress and every outcome, and notes written by Runs of the same Round are left out, so Runs of one Round never observe each other (ADR-0010).
